file_name: Questionnaire - Wesfarmers and Built Group – Built Living Joint Venture.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if there are not many alternatives to Wesfarmers (including Bunnings Warehouse) and/or Built Group, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.

If Wesfarmers supplies Built Group and/or Built Living with most or all of their construction inputs as a result of the Acquisition, will there remain sufficient alternative customers for competing suppliers of construction inputs?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Wesfarmers and/or Built Group.
